feedback.symptom: tiny holes in the print; the pegs pair's border is too big and the pegs fit too tight
feedback.cause: the slice ran on Studio's built-in defaults, not the X2D preset: our slicer passed only the top preset file and Studio's command line does not follow `inherits`, so elephant-foot compensation was 0 (preset 0.15), the top was 4 layers / 0.6 mm (preset 5 / 1.0), walls were Arachne and the top zig-zag. The holes fit those settings; the tight pegs fit compensation 0 plus the slot shape; the border is the dovetail frame rule by design. Causes ranked in docs/design/printing/print-quality-design.md; none measured.
feedback.next: flatten the preset chain and re-slice minis-04 to compare previews; fix the slot offset in bikar; then a clearance ladder at 1.4 mm (T1) before CAL-FIT-01 moves; the narrower joins are on minis-05 and minis-06
